info.name: The Cave of the Black Witch

descriptions.notStarted: I better go visit the #bCave of the #o9001010##k as instructed by #p2081012#.
descriptions.inProgress: There was a note posted on the wall of the cave. After reading the note, I noticed that it may have been written by #p1103000#. The subject of the curse was not found, but the device was found, recovered, and sent back to Ereve. I may have been one step too late. #p1103000# must have completed his assignment already. I better return to #bEreve#k.
